title: Shabbar ka Janaza Jaata Hain aur Teer Layeen Barsaat e Hain
body:
Shabbar ka janaza jaata hain aur teer layeen barsaat e hain
Abbas ke badley hai tewar shabbir unhe samjate hai
1. Bhai ki wasiyat par humko karna hai amal aye mere jari
Yun sabr o reza ki manzil par shamsheer nahi chamkatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Taboote Hassan par teeroun ki bohchar jo kartey hai aadaa
Yeh zulm to kafir bhi na karen mayyat pa layeen jo dhatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Pehloo mein nawasa dafan na ho nana ke ji kehtey hai aadaa
Wo roohe nabi o zehra ko marqad mein bohat tadpatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dafana ke Hassan ke laashey ko kadmoo mein janab e zehra ke
Turbat pe Hassan ke sibtey nabi aankhoun se lahoo barsaatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tha zeher se tukdey qalb e Hassan phir ispe chalaye teer e sitam
Roo roo ke nabi ke rouze par yeh sibte nabi farmatey hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aathara bani Hashim ke jigar is gham se howe tukdey mazher
Mayyat ko kisi ki soucho zara dobaar koi nehlaatey ha
Azz:-Mazhar abedi
